verdict.rationale: An in-app AI assistant that personalizes its output is a fair capability for a project-management SaaS, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows external AI agents connecting through MCP, the CLI, or Skills, and inviting agents into projects. Nothing shows a built-in assistant that learns a user's tone, shorthand, or preferences.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have my in-app AI assistant learn my tone, shorthand, and preferences to tailor its output
